name: Shenzhen Open 2019

organisers.name: [{Shenzhen Cube Association (深圳市魔方协会)}{mailto:shenzhencubing@163.com}] [{Shenzhen Futian Mind Sports Association (深圳市福田区智力运动协会)}{mailto:szmindsports@163.com}]

venue.name: Four Points by Sheraton Shenzhen Hotel

information: The competition is organized by Shenzhen Cube Association (深圳市魔方协会) and Shenzhen Futian Mind Sports Association (深圳市福田区智力运动协会), in the support of Shenzhen Bureau of Culture and Sport (深圳市文体局). The competition takes two days from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. at the weekend. Meanwhile, there'll be some different fun events, interactive sessions and cube-related speeches among the official rounds. Alongside the competition, we have a cube-theme exhibition at the corridor, and a puzzle challenge booth at the back of the venue. Welcome to join us! By holding this event, we hope more people get to know the cube, understand it and enjoy its fun!
